_about: Length budgets for summary, highlight cards, and sections. Not copied from the discarded handoff price tiers. Source bands are the current pipeline sectionLengthPlan (2026-09-17 measured: opening 1200-1600, highlight 1100-1500, standard 450-700, observed mean 868). Two-pass formula: min = smaller * 0.9, max = larger * 1.35.
